concept: Cozy literary palette for Yellow Bird Books: a calm sage forest-green primary paired with a soft handmade gold accent and warm ochre secondary, set in deep warm-brown ink on creamy paper backgrounds. Inviting, calm, and bookish - like a well-worn reading nook lit by afternoon light.
contrastNotes: All required ratios pass WCAG-AA. ink #3A2A1E on bg #FBF6EA = 12.73:1 (>=7). ink-soft #6E5A46 on bg = 6.06:1 (>=4.5). white on primary #4C6B4E = 5.97:1 (>=4.5). primary on bg = 5.53:1 (>=3). Extras: ink on surface 13.49:1, ink on surface-alt 11.47:1, white on primary-dark #374F38 = 8.98:1, ink on accent #C9A227 = 5.67:1. Accent gold (2.24:1 on bg) and secondary ochre are decorative/large-text only - not used for body text on bg.
